inputs.text: [excited] ig… WAH… noh… don. [curious] "Iguano" comes from iguana, a big lizard. And "odon," in Greek, is tooth.
[happily] Exactly, [warmly] his teeth really looked like an iguana's. He lived in Europe and North America, a hundred twenty-five million years ago.
[curious] Is he one of the very first dinosaurs ever found?
[proud] Yes, one of the very first. [amazed] Discovered in Belgium, a very long time ago.
